contexts.text: To the least jot, they signify... AC 1783. AC 2763:2.
As to the least jot is inspired. AC 1886. AC 2310:3. AC 4642:3. AC 4726:2.
Such affections... are in every jot...
The Word as to the least jot is Divine. AC 8891:3. AC 8971.
The internal sense flows from every jot.
All things are representative, even to the least jot.
Each and all things, even to every jot, treat of the Lord; and therefore it is said that one jot or one tittle shall not pass in the Law...
There is not a point, or a jot, in the Original Language, which does not affect the Angels...
There is not a jot, or point, or little horn, in the letter of the Word, which does not contain the holy Divine in it. Illustrated.
The Word is Divine as to every jot.
Hence it is that in the Word there are Divine things and arcana of Heaven even in its jots, points, and little horns.

The books of the Word have been preserved entire even to a jot from the time when they were written... This has been provided by the Lord on account of the holiness which there is in every jot, letter, word, and thing.
Hence it was evident what is signified by every jot, point, and little horn of the Law... DeVerbo 4:end.
In the celestial writings each letter is formed of inflected lines with little horns above and beneath; and there are jots or points in the letters, and also beneath and above them...
